name: Valley fog, late summer
story: The longer, cooler nights fill every valley with fog: from the club the island is a sea of white with the ridges standing out of it. It holds until ten, then melts from the edges in, and the afternoon is fine.
forecast: Fog in the valleys and on the water at dawn, visibility under 1 km, lifting 09:30-10:30. Then fair, light west wind. Clear, dark night.
